## GEOGRAPHY linestrings and the functions over them
# Source: https://cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/reference/standard-sql/geography_functions
# The examples of ST_ISCLOSED, ST_CLUSTERDBSCAN, ST_MAKELINE, ST_POINTN, ST_STARTPOINT and
# ST_ENDPOINT give the WKT of linestrings; the descriptions of ST_GEOMETRYTYPE, ST_DIMENSION,
# ST_NUMPOINTS, ST_ISCOLLECTION, ST_AREA, ST_PERIMETER, ST_EQUALS and the distance functions give
# the rest, and those of ST_X, ST_Y, S2_CELLIDFROMPOINT and the linestring accessors say SAFE.
# turns their errors into NULL.

SELECT ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 1, 4 3, 2 6, 0 1)')
=> "LINESTRING(0 1, 4 3, 2 6, 0 1)"

SELECT ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(2 6, 1 3, 3 9)')
=> "LINESTRING(2 6, 1 3, 3 9)"

SELECT ST_ASTEXT(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(40 1, 42 34, 44 39)'))
=> "LINESTRING(40 1, 42 34, 44 39)"

CREATE TEMP TABLE line_geo AS SELECT ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(2 6, 1 3, 3 9)') AS g; SELECT g FROM line_geo
=> "LINESTRING(2 6, 1 3, 3 9)"

SELECT ST_ISCLOSED(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 1, 4 3, 2 6, 0 1)'))
=> "true"

SELECT ST_ISCLOSED(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(2 6, 1 3, 3 9)'))
=> "false"

SELECT ST_GEOMETRYTYPE(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(2 6, 1 3, 3 9)'))
=> "ST_LineString"

SELECT ST_DIMENSION(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(2 6, 1 3, 3 9)'))
=> "1"

SELECT ST_NUMPOINTS(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(2 6, 1 3, 3 9)'))
=> "3"

SELECT ST_NPOINTS(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(2 6, 1 3, 3 9)'))
=> "3"

SELECT ST_ISEMPTY(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(2 6, 1 3, 3 9)'))
=> "false"

SELECT ST_ISCOLLECTION(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(2 6, 1 3, 3 9)'))
=> "false"

# Lines have no area or perimeter.
SELECT ST_AREA(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(2 6, 1 3, 3 9)'))
=> "0.0"

SELECT ST_PERIMETER(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(2 6, 1 3, 3 9)'))
=> "0.0"

SELECT ST_LENGTH(CAST(NULL AS GEOGRAPHY))
=> null

# A point covers no line, and an empty geography is at no distance.
SELECT ST_EQUALS(ST_GEOGPOINT(2, 6), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(2 6, 1 3, 3 9)'))
=> "false"

SELECT ST_EQUALS(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(2 6, 1 3, 3 9)'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT EMPTY'))
=> "false"

SELECT ST_DISTANCE(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(2 6, 1 3, 3 9)'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT EMPTY'))
=> null

SELECT ST_MAXDISTANCE(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT EMPTY'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(2 6, 1 3, 3 9)'))
=> null

SELECT ST_DWITHIN(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(2 6, 1 3, 3 9)'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT EMPTY'), 1000)
=> "false"

SELECT SAFE.ST_X(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(2 6, 1 3, 3 9)'))
=> null

SELECT SAFE.ST_Y(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(2 6, 1 3, 3 9)'))
=> null

SELECT SAFE.S2_CELLIDFROMPOINT(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(2 6, 1 3, 3 9)'))
=> null

SELECT ST_POINTN(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(1 1, 2 1, 3 2, 3 3)'), 1)
=> "POINT(1 1)"

SELECT ST_POINTN(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(1 1, 2 1, 3 2, 3 3)'), -1)
=> "POINT(3 3)"

SELECT ST_POINTN(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(1 1, 2 1, 3 2, 3 3)'), 2)
=> "POINT(2 1)"

SELECT ST_POINTN(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(1 1, 2 1, 3 2, 3 3)'), -2)
=> "POINT(3 2)"

SELECT ST_STARTPOINT(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(1 1, 2 1, 3 2, 3 3)'))
=> "POINT(1 1)"

SELECT ST_ENDPOINT(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(1 1, 2 1, 3 2, 3 3)'))
=> "POINT(3 3)"

SELECT ST_STARTPOINT(CAST(NULL AS GEOGRAPHY))
=> null

# Each accessor fails for anything but a linestring, and ST_POINTN where there is no vertex.
SELECT SAFE.ST_STARTPOINT(ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 1))
=> null

SELECT SAFE.ST_ENDPOINT(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT EMPTY'))
=> null

SELECT SAFE.ST_POINTN(ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 1), 1)
=> null

SELECT SAFE.ST_POINTN(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(1 1, 2 1, 3 2, 3 3)'), 5)
=> null

SELECT SAFE.ST_POINTN(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(1 1, 2 1, 3 2, 3 3)'), -5)
=> null

SELECT SAFE.ST_POINTN(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(1 1, 2 1, 3 2, 3 3)'), 0)
=> null

SELECT ST_MAKELINE([ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 2), ST_GEOGPOINT(2, 3)])
=> "LINESTRING(1 2, 2 3)"

# Points snapped together make a point, and a line's vertices are its own.
SELECT ST_MAKELINE([ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 2), ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 2)])
=> "POINT(1 2)"

SELECT ST_MAKELINE([ST_MAKELINE(ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 2), ST_GEOGPOINT(2, 3)), ST_MAKELINE(ST_GEOGPOINT(2, 3), ST_GEOGPOINT(3, 4)), ST_MAKELINE(ST_GEOGPOINT(3, 4), ST_GEOGPOINT(4, 5))])
=> "LINESTRING(1 2, 2 3, 3 4, 4 5)"

SELECT ST_MAKELINE(ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 2), NULL)
=> null

SELECT ST_MAKELINE(NULL, ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 2))
=> null

SELECT ST_MAKELINE([ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 2), NULL])
=> null

SELECT ST_MAKELINE(CAST(NULL AS ARRAY<GEOGRAPHY>))
=> null

# BigQuery's answers to unverified cases.

SELECT ST_GEOGFROMTEXT(' linestring ( 1 2 ,3 4 ) ')
=> "LINESTRING(1 2, 3 4)"

SELECT ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0.1 0.2, 0.30000000000000004 1)')
=> "LINESTRING(0.1 0.2, 0.3 1)"

SELECT ST_X(ST_POINTN(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0.1 0.2, 0.30000000000000004 1)'), 2))
=> "0.3000000000000001"

SELECT ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 0.5 0, 1 0)')
=> "LINESTRING(0 0, 0.5 0, 1 0)"

SELECT ST_NUMPOINTS(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 0.5 0, 1 0)'))
=> "3"

SELECT ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(1 2)')
=> error: ST_GeogFromText failed: Linestring should have at least two points, but had 1 point

SELECT ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(1 2 3 4)')
=> error: ST_GeogFromText failed: Expected ',' or ')', but saw '3' at position 15.

SELECT ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(1 2, 3)')
=> error: ST_GeogFromText failed: Expected latitude, but saw ')' at position 17.

SELECT ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(1 2,)')
=> error: ST_GeogFromText failed: Expected longitude, but saw ')' at position 15.

SELECT ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(1 2, 3 4')
=> error: ST_GeogFromText failed: Expected ',' or ')', but saw end of data at position 19.

SELECT ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 0 91)')
=> error: ST_GeogFromText failed: Latitude must be between -90 and 90 degrees. Actual value was 91

SELECT ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 0 0, 1 1)')
=> "LINESTRING(0 0, 1 1)"

SELECT ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 1e-12 0, 1 1)')
=> "LINESTRING(0 0, 1 1)"

SELECT ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 0 0)')
=> "POINT(0 0)"

SELECT ST_NUMPOINTS(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 0 0, 1 1)'))
=> "2"

SELECT ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 1 1, 0 0)')
=> "LINESTRING(0 0, 1 1)"

SELECT ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 2 2, 0 2, 2 0)')
=> "LINESTRING(0 0, 1 1.00045705372412, 2 2, 0 2, 1 1.00045705372412, 2 0)"

SELECT ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 1 0, 1 1, 0.5 0)')
=> "LINESTRING(0 0, 0.5 0, 1 0, 1 1, 0.5 0)"

SELECT ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 1 0, 1 1, 0 0, -1 -1)')
=> "LINESTRING(0 0, 1 0, 1 1, 0 0, -1 -1)"

SELECT ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 1 0, 1 1, 0 1, 0 0)')
=> "LINESTRING(0 0, 1 0, 1 1, 0 1, 0 0)"

SELECT ST_NUMPOINTS(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 1 0, 1 1, 0 1, 0 0)'))
=> "5"

SELECT ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 1 0, 1 1, 0 1, 0 0, 0 -1)')
=> "LINESTRING(0 0, 1 0, 1 1, 0 1, 0 0, 0 -1)"

SELECT ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(-30 0, 150 0)')
=> error: ST_GeogFromText failed: Invalid linestring: Vertices 0 and 1 are antipodal

SELECT ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 180 0)')
=> error: ST_GeogFromText failed: Invalid linestring: Vertices 0 and 1 are antipodal

SELECT ST_LENGTH(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 1 0)'))
=> "111195.10117748393"

SELECT ST_LENGTH(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(-122.35 47.62, 139.69 35.69)'))
=> "7694475.565758301"

SELECT ST_LENGTH(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 1 0, 1 1)'))
=> "222390.20235496783"

SELECT ST_LENGTH(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 1 0)'), TRUE)
=> error: ST_LENGTH does not yet implement use_spheroid=true

SELECT ST_DISTANCE(ST_GEOGPOINT(0.5, 1), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 1 0)'))
=> "111195.10117748393"

SELECT ST_DISTANCE(ST_GEOGPOINT(2, 0), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 1 0)'))
=> "111195.10117748393"

SELECT ST_DISTANCE(ST_GEOGPOINT(0.5, 0), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 1 0)'))
=> "1.4146483984234237E-9"

SELECT ST_DISTANCE(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 1 0)'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 1, 1 1)'))
=> "111195.10117748393"

SELECT ST_DISTANCE(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 -1, 0 1)'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(-1 0, 1 0)'))
=> "0.0"

SELECT ST_DWITHIN(ST_GEOGPOINT(0.5, 0), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 1 0)'), 0)
=> "true"

SELECT ST_DWITHIN(ST_GEOGPOINT(0.5, 1), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 1 0)'), 111196)
=> "true"

SELECT ST_DWITHIN(ST_GEOGPOINT(0.5, 1), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 1 0)'), 111195)
=> "false"

SELECT ST_MAXDISTANCE(ST_GEOGPOINT(0.5, 1), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 1 0)'))
=> "124318.64012685922"

SELECT ST_MAXDISTANCE(ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(170 10, -170 10)'))
=> "1.88863676540262E7"

SELECT ST_MAXDISTANCE(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 1 0, 1 1)'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 1 0, 1 1)'))
=> "157249.6280925079"

SELECT ST_X(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(1 1, 2 1)'))
=> error: Argument to ST_X must be a single point geography; an argument contained a line.

SELECT ST_Y(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(1 1, 2 1)'))
=> error: Argument to ST_Y must be a single point geography; an argument contained a line.

SELECT ST_AZIMUTH(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(1 1, 2 1)'), ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0))
=> error: ST_Azimuth: Argument to STAzimuth must be a single point geography; an argument contained a line.

SELECT S2_CELLIDFROMPOINT(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(1 1, 2 1)'))
=> error: S2_CellIdFromPoint: Argument to S2CellIdFromPoint must be a single point geography; an argument contained a line.

SELECT ST_GEOHASH(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(1 1, 2 1)'))
=> error: ST_GeoHash: Argument to ST_GeoHash must be a single point geography.

SELECT SAFE.ST_GEOHASH(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(1 1, 2 1)'))
=> error: SAFE with function st_geohash is not supported.

SELECT ST_STARTPOINT(ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 1))
=> error: The input is not a single LINESTRING

SELECT ST_ENDPOINT(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT EMPTY'))
=> error: The input is not a single LINESTRING

SELECT ST_POINTN(ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 1), 1)
=> error: The input is not a single LINESTRING

SELECT ST_POINTN(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(1 1, 2 1)'), 3)
=> error: The vertex index 3 is out of bounds; input LINESTRING has 2 points.

SELECT ST_POINTN(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(1 1, 2 1)'), 0)
=> error: The vertex index 0 is out of bounds; input LINESTRING has 2 points.

SELECT ST_POINTN(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(1 1, 2 1)'), NULL)
=> null

SELECT ST_MAKELINE(ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT EMPTY'))
=> error: ST_MAKELINE arguments must be single points or lines

SELECT ST_MAKELINE(CAST([] AS ARRAY<GEOGRAPHY>))
=> error: ST_MAKELINE failed: Linestring should have at least two points, but had 0 points

SELECT ST_MAKELINE([ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 2)])
=> "POINT(1 2)"

SELECT ST_MAKELINE([ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(1 2, 3 4)')])
=> "LINESTRING(1 2, 3 4)"

SELECT ST_MAKELINE(ST_GEOGPOINT(-30, 0), ST_GEOGPOINT(150, 0))
=> error: Invalid linestring: Vertices 0 and 1 are antipodal

SELECT ST_MAKELINE(ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0), ST_GEOGPOINT(180, 0))
=> error: Invalid linestring: Vertices 0 and 1 are antipodal

SELECT ST_MAKELINE(ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0), ST_GEOGPOINT(1e-12, 0))
=> "POINT(0 0)"

SELECT ST_MAKELINE([ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0), ST_GEOGPOINT(1, 0), ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0)])
=> "LINESTRING(0 0, 1 0)"

SELECT ST_MAKELINE(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 1 0)'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(1 0, 2 0)'))
=> "LINESTRING(0 0, 1 0, 2 0)"
